positive_snippets: I had a wonderful experience during my stay here. The service provided was appreciated. Food too was upto the mark. Charges were reasonable too. I would definitely stay here again whenever I visit.
Only affordable property near the University North campus in Dehli. The owner is a great person and very supportive.

Ravi and Pulak both take care of guest very warmly. I had stayed multiple times and my experience is very good.

Prof. Manoj Chhaparia
negative_snippets: I visited the place for a business exhibition. This place has a banquet hall like setting. The food is tasty but washroom is not properly clean. AC was also not working properly or due to the crowd it felt so.

Rooms have 40 years old facilities. Lacks basic amenities: Stinky rooms, no exhaust in bathroom, geyser problem, etc.

Instead of improving the facilities, the manager is argumentative.

Tarrif is very high and unreasonable, around 2000+ per night.

No refund policies.

I strongly do not recommend this hotel.
